name: Clock
description: The current time, local or at a fixed UTC offset, 24h or 12h, with an optional label such as a city.

params.name: label
params.help: Small line above the time, e.g. London (empty: none)

params.name: use_local
params.help: true: this computer's time zone; false: use utc_offset

params.name: utc_offset
params.help: Hours from UTC when use_local is false, e.g. -5, 1, 5.5 (no daylight saving: give the current offset)
